summary: Executed backend + frontend regression on public preview URL for the major archive upgrade. Backend API coverage passed (including seasons 2007–2025, 2020 exact values, victory field expansion, and #105 Belgian 2024). Most UI/integration requirements passed; one frontend interaction issue found in gallery navigation controls.

ui_bugs.issue: Previous/Next gallery controls do not change horizontal strip scroll position during automation validation (scrollLeft remained 0 -> 0 -> 0).

action_items: Fix gallery control behavior so button clicks reliably advance/reverse the horizontal strip (verify scrollLeft changes).
Re-run focused UI regression for gallery controls after fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend App.css and Upgrade.css are highly compressed single-line files, which significantly reduce maintainability and increase review/debug friction.
Nav home logo uses go('top') but there is no element id='top', so top navigation is only partially effective (did not return to absolute top in validation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests now validate expanded archive contract: 19 seasons (2007-2025), required season fields, exact 2020 metrics, full victory field set, and chronological numbering with Belgian 2024 as #105. Frontend passed timeline/nav/records/milestones/overflow/image-load checks on desktop+mobile. Remaining failed area: gallery prev/next controls did not move strip scrollLeft in Playwright run.
rca of the issue: Repro: open visual gallery, read [data-testid='gallery-image-strip'].scrollLeft, click next/previous buttons, re-check scrollLeft. Observed unchanged 0 across attempts while strip had overflow width. Probable root area is the button click -> move() -> strip.current.scrollBy path not producing effective horizontal movement under runtime conditions.
